title: NPC Definition
description: Schema for defining Non-Player Characters in the game.

id.description: Unique identifier string for the NPC (e.g., 'npc_boat_captain'). Should match the filename.

name.description: The display name shown to the player (e.g., 'Boat Captain').

description.description: Text displayed when the NPC is first seen or examined initially.

examined_description.description: Optional text displayed when the NPC is examined closely or repeatedly.

dialog_ref.description: Optional reference key/ID for the starting node/file of this NPC's primary dialog tree.

on_attack_dialog_ref.description: Optional reference to a dialog sequence triggered when player attacks this NPC while not hostile.

state.description: Initial state of the NPC (e.g., 'neutral', 'hostile', 'dead', 'quest_stage_1'). Default: 'neutral'.

hostile.description: Whether the NPC starts as hostile to the player. Default: false.

faction.description: Optional faction affiliation (e.g., 'boat_crew', 'island_guard', 'mutant'). Used for ally checks.

aliases.description: Optional list of alternative lowercase names the player can use to refer to the NPC.

stats.description: Optional object containing NPC statistics relevant for combat or checks.

inventory.description: Optional list of item IDs the NPC starts with.

equipped_items.description: Optional mapping of equipment slots to item IDs.

initial_fondness.description: The starting disposition value of the NPC towards the player (e.g., 0=neutral).
